name: io.github.aselimc/arcgis-sdk-mcp
title: ArcGIS SDK and Developer Docs (unofficial)
description: Unofficial, not affiliated with Esri. On-demand ArcGIS developer docs for coding agents.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_DOCS_SOURCES
environmentVariables.description: Source policy: a preset (strict or standard) and/or +capability / -capability, comma separated. Default: standard.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_DOCS_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to answer from the local cache only.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_DOCS_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory. Default: the per-user cache directory.

environmentVariables.name: ARCGIS_DOCS_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Project in which installed Esri SDK versions are detected. Default: the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token; raises the API quota used for Esri's sample repositories from 60 to 5000 requests per hour.
